svg.title: Ashzaeen Fatmi Khan. I build useful things, end to end.
svg.desc: A little gold companion with headphones, Pip, stands on a tiny planet while six things I have built roll past one by one, each with its name: a finance app with a shopping copilot, an Android app that scans food and suggests recipes, smart glasses that list cars and homes, web publishing tools for UTA IT, an iOS app with an AI dashboard for Meta glasses, research on why robot vision fails.
svg.text: I build useful things, end to end.

g.text: Android app: scan food, get recipes
smart glasses that list cars + homes

Meta glasses: iOS app + AI dashboard
